description: Doubao WLED Light Recipe Skill - config file. Copy to config.json and fill in your values.

wled.note: Leave ip/mdns_name empty to enable auto-discovery. Or fill in your WLED IP for faster connection. Example: ip=192.168.1.100, mdns_name=wled-ab12cd

layout.description: LED strip layout type: tv_backlight, linear, ring, or matrix
layout.note: Set total_leds and edges to match your physical LED strip. total_leds=0 means auto-detect from device. For tv_backlight, fill top/bottom/left/right LED counts.

recipe_storage.note: custom_palette_id_* refer to /palette{N}.json FILE indexes, not runtime palette IDs. On WLED 16.x the runtime ID is 200-N (built-ins occupy 0-71, custom 72-200). Scripts convert for you.

effect_mapping.note: FX IDs must be resolved from live GET /json/effects by English name (see scripts/resolve_fx.py). Do not hard-code IDs across WLED versions.

adb.note: Optional: ADB device address for pushing recipe images to screen (e.g. Android TV, amplifier with screen). Set device to '192.168.2.43:5555' format. Leave empty to open images locally instead.

safety.note: 写入门禁。真正写入局域网 WLED 前，必须先让用户确认处于豆包『办公模式（办公任务）』，再执行 python3 scripts/guard.py --enable --confirm-office-mode。默认 false=锁定。

video.note: 视频取色。frames=抽取关键帧数(6-10较合适)；mode=scene(按画面切换)或 even(均匀)；edge_band_ratio=四边色带高度比例；palette_id=/palette{N}.json 文件索引(需重启 WLED 才在 ID 200-N 上可见；视频配方默认用每段 col 直写，不依赖它)。

realtime.note: 外部实时流(屏幕同步软件等)冲突时的默认策略。auto=先退出实时模式，抢不回来才用 lor=2 优先级接管；on=总是接管；off=不接管(只提示)。覆写：--takeover auto|on|off。交还控制权：python3 scripts/apply_recipe.py --release

sync.note: WLED 主从同步。group 为组位掩码(1=第1组)。需同时写 if.sync.send.en 和运行时 state.udpn.send，两者都为真才会真正广播(见 sync_devices.py --setup)。从设备会开启 recv.seg/recv.sb，否则四段式光配方会退化成整条同色。所有设备需相同 WLED 版本，否则同步包里的 FX id 会错位。
